question:
Six persons, P, Q, R, S, T and U travelled in different months of the same year viz. January, February, March, July, September and December.

U travelled in September. Only one person travelled between U and Q. No one travelled between P and S. S travelled in a month after P. More than two people travelled between S and T. Who among them travelled in March?
